location.subnational: Gauteng - City of Johannesburg Metropolitan Municipality

notes: ADC's JHB1 campus in Midrand (City of Johannesburg) has ~8,500 sq m white space with up to 20MW IT load capacity (two 10MW facilities; latest hyperscale data centre completed 2021). 2N UPS topology with ~10 minutes battery autonomy at full load. ADC is Cassava Technologies' data centre arm.
